diagram_previews.alt: The unit cube in oblique view with axes x (into the page), y and z; a blue slanted prism runs from the square [0, 1/2] x [0, 1/2] on the face x = 0 to the shaded square at x = 1/2, and red edges join that square to the apex (1,1,1), forming a pyramid.

difficulty_rationale: Needs the reformulation as "range at most 1/2" and a volume computation in the unit cube split into a prism and a pyramid.
